name: Scroll Path Morph
description: Long editorial scroll page where SVG wave separators, clipped images and line waves morph their paths as they scroll through the viewport, with full-screen photo sections and serif headings.
contents: Full-screen photo sections with wavy top and bottom edges
Text block beside a clipped tall image
Staggered grid of four clipped images
Wave line illustrations around a heading
Vertical interlude text and stacked wide clipped images
Dark footer with blob-clipped image, heading and wave lines
behavior: SVG path shapes morph from start to end shape scrubbed to scroll position
Grid columns offset vertically from 768px up and stack on mobile

Love of truth, without love of learning, sinks into cruelty. Love of straightness, without love of learning, sinks into rudeness. Love of daring, without love of learning, sinks into turbulence. Love of strength, without love of learning, sinks into oddity.

editableByProps: All headings, body text, interlude text and footer heading
Images, background, text, footer and line colors, fonts
Scrub, smooth scroll, lerp and grid width

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the morph shapes of the separators

needsCodeEdit.where: CLIP_TALL, CLIP_GRID, CLIP_WIDE and CLIP_BLOB constants

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Lenis and the scroll triggers are destroyed on unmount
Section layout, image slots and count are fixed in code
Includes tall padding blocks between sections to give the morphs scroll room
